title: Inspect endpoint not accessible or non-functional
description: The agent claimed no CLI command exists for the inspect endpoint and marked it as an issue, but verification shows the inspect endpoint was never called (0 requests). This suggests either the endpoint doesn't exist, isn't documented, or the agent couldn't discover how to access it.
reproduction_steps: Obtain access to a test API credential
Attempt to use the inspect endpoint to preview a broker call without executing it
expected_behavior: Agent should be able to call an inspect endpoint (either via CLI or direct API) to preview what a broker call would do without executing it.
actual_behavior: Agent could not find or access the inspect endpoint. Verification shows 0 requests to any inspect-related endpoint. Task marked as FAILED.
evidence: Agent narration claims no CLI command exists for inspect endpoint and marks as issue
verification shows inspect endpoint was never called (0 requests). Task FAILED.
